Admissions Process

Your journey to knowledge starts here. Follow our simple steps to enroll.

How to Apply

1. Submit Application

Complete the online application form with accurate details.

2. Schedule Interview

Book a convenient time for your admissions interview.

3. Receive Offer

Successful candidates will receive an offer of admission.

4. Enroll & Begin

Confirm your enrollment and start your learning journey!

Admission Requirements

Undergraduate Programs

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum GPA of 3.0.
  • Standardized test scores (SAT/ACT) may be required.
  • Personal essay and letters of recommendation.

Graduate Programs

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
  • Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) scores.
  • Statement of purpose.
  • At least two academic or professional references.
